name: toast
summary: Presents a bounded set of transient feedback messages with safe navigation actions.

agent.useWhen: A page needs a short, dismissible transient update or progress message with an optional real destination.
agent.avoidWhen: The content is durable page guidance, field validation, a command, or app/server-owned message generation.

invariants: A toast region contains one to eight messages; titles and bodies are nonblank plain text escaped at render.
Tone is info, success, warning, danger, or progress and selects only closed locked icon geometry.
Action href and label are paired; destinations must be safe navigation URLs. App code owns canonical message creation and meaning.
Dismiss labels are localized by the caller and default to Dismiss notification; a null dismissLabel omits the usable dismiss control.
Optional timeout is an integer from 1000 through 60000 milliseconds; its timer pauses during focus, hover, and hidden-document periods and is cleaned up on teardown.
History policy is reset, preserve, or remove and restoration uses owned DOM snapshots, never HTML strings.
Without JavaScript all messages remain visible; there are no network requests, commands, or route ownership.
The fragment has exactly one [[toastRegion]] substitution slot.
